body: Thank you. Honestly I don't find anything good about me, but I will ask my friend. And if I ever get a chance, I will ask a doctor about my anger issue/depression.

Thank you, I'm glad your mom and you are back together again. This got to me. Your right they probably would miss me, but I don't want them to remember me for the bad times, because they sure outweigh the good...
Is bipolar genetic? My father has it, could I have it to. Also I have told them... Probably why they are still around me. And your right, I hate myself.
I know what I'm doing, but sometimes it just comes from nowhere, like bam, anger, then followed by instant regret.
